source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Rh system, block for block, with the Kitab ki ghalti box (PDF 94-95).

blocks.text: Rh system insanon ka doosra sab se ahem blood group system hai. Is ka naam (Rh) Rhesus bandar se liya gaya hai, jis mein is ka antigen sab se pehle Landsteiner ne daryaft kiya; kitab is ka zamana 1930s batati hai (aam taur par yeh daryaft 1940 mein Landsteiner aur Wiener se mansoob hai). Yeh system RBCs par Rh-antigen (jise Rh factor ya antigen-D bhi kehte hain) ke hone ya na hone par mabni hai. Jin logon mein yeh antigen ho woh Rh-positive, aur jin mein na ho woh Rh-negative kehlate hain.

blocks.alt: Do red blood cells. Bare cell, Rh-positive fard ka RBC, ki satah par chhote gol antigen-D nishan hain; doosra, Rh-negative fard ka RBC, in ke baghair hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.5: Rh blood group nizam (kitab ki Figure 18.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Antigen-D, RBC of Rh-positive individual, RBC of Rh-negative individual.

blocks.text: Aam taur par kisi ka blood group batate waqt ABO aur Rh dono systems saath bataye jate hain. Misaal: jis ke paas antigen-A aur Rh-antigen dono hon us ka blood group A-positive hai; jis ke paas antigen-A ho lekin Rh-antigen na ho us ka A-negative. B, AB aur O groups ke saath bhi yahi hai.

Rh blood group system ko aik gene 'D' control karta hai. Is ke do alleles hain: D aur d. Dominant allele D Rh-antigen banata hai, jab ke recessive allele d Rh-antigen nahi banata. Is liye DD ya Dd genotype wale logon mein Rh-antigen hota hai aur woh Rh-positive hain, jab ke dd wale logon mein Rh-antigen nahi hota aur woh Rh-negative hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne chhapa hai ke recessive allele d Rh antigen ke banne ko rokta (inhibit karta) hai. Yeh sahi nahi: agar d rokta to Dd shakhs mein bhi antigen na banta, halanke Dd Rh-positive hota hai. Sahi baat yeh hai ke d allele Rh antigen banata hi nahi; is liye D ki aik copy bhi antigen ke liye kaafi hai aur sirf dd log Rh-negative hote hain.
Rh system mein transfusion ka usool

ABO blood groups mein anti-A ya anti-B antibodies plasma mein pehle se hoti hain. Lekin Rh system mein Rh-negative logon mein qudrati taur par anti-Rh antibodies nahi hotin. Agar Rh-negative shakhs ko Rh-positive khoon diya jaye to us ka jism anti-Rh antibodies banane lagta hai, jo diye gaye RBCs ko tabah karti hain. Yeh antibodies umr bhar jism mein rehti hain.

O-negative asal universal donor hai, kyunke is par na ABO system ka koi antigen hai na Rh system ka antigen. AB-positive asal universal recipient hai, kyunke is mein na anti-A, na anti-B aur na anti-Rh antibodies hain; is liye yeh kisi bhi donor ka khoon le sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Rh-negative shakhs ko pehli baar Rh-positive khoon diya jaye to aam taur par fauran masla kyun nahi hota, lekin doosri baar ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Us mein pehle se anti-Rh antibodies nahi hotin; pehli baar ka khoon unhein banana shuru karwata hai. Yeh antibodies umr bhar rehti hain, is liye agli baar Rh-positive khoon diya jaye to woh RBCs par hamla karti hain.

items: Rh system: antigen-D ho to Rh-positive, na ho to Rh-negative.
DD ya Dd Rh-positive, dd Rh-negative; d antigen banata hi nahi.
Anti-Rh antibodies sirf Rh-positive khoon milne ke baad banti aur umr bhar rehti hain.
O-negative asal universal donor, AB-positive asal universal recipient.
